data.name: Bahushruta
data.gender_notes: Bahushruta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bahus means 'many' and Shruta means 'heard', thus Bahushruta means 'he who has heard much' or 'learned'. The name Bahushruta carries the meaning “Learned, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Bahushruta usually hope their child will grow to embody learned, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and intelligence. It is a name for those who have a thirst for knowledge and a desire to learn and grow.
data.etymology: Bahushruta belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Learned, Scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahushruta total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bahushruta is associated with Sage Bahushruta, who is believed to be the author of the ancient Hindu text "Bahushruti Samhita", also known as "Shalakya Samhita". This text is one of the oldest treatises in South Asian medicine, focusing on surgical, medical, and instrumental techniques. The name Bahushruta signifies a scholar, a wise man, someone with vast knowledge and understanding in a particular field.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, learning is considered a sacred duty and a means to reach self-realization and ultimately, attain moksha or salvation. Bahushruta represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom in all areas of life, from worldly to spiritual. This name carries the message to continuously acquire knowledge, listen to scriptures, and understand the divine teachings, in order to attain spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bahushruta: The name Bahushruta signifies one who has mastered many healing techniques or possesses vast knowledge in the field of Ayurvedic medicine. It is derived from two Sanskrit words, 'bahu' meaning many and 'shruta' meaning heard, indicating one who has extensively learned and practiced various healing methods.

historical_references.reference: Bahushruta was a celebrated physician and surgeon in ancient India, who is mentioned in various Indian literary works including the Charaka Samhita and the Sushruta Samhita. He is believed to have lived during the 2nd century BC.

Bahushruta is also known as the 'father of Indian surgery', and is considered one of the earliest surgeons in the Indian subcontinent. He is believed to have made significant contributions to the field of surgery, including performing complex operations on the eyelids and conducting successful skull trepanations.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Bahushruta continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
